evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies getrawtransaction error handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp and node::GetTransaction.
rationale: Calls to getrawtransaction and REST endpoints misreported disk read failures as missing transactions ('No such transaction found in the provided block'). Differentiating internal read and corruption errors from absent transactions stops callers from receiving misleading status codes on hardware or block file errors.
